summary: Add bounded Avatar-model discovery and explicit adapter configuration, versioned label mapping, raw visual observations, multi-frame visual spans, visual-first identity fusion, strict trusted-speech/lexicon/acoustic bootstrap, profile-isolated Adaptive ASR Shadow, Product GUI status, and Human Review v2 checks without manufacturing real results.
compatibility: Schema v2 is forward-only and idempotent. Existing creator_profile_v1 and memory are preserved. New profile versions do not reuse incompatible memory by default. Generic ASR remains authoritative and the feature remains Shadow-only.
risks: Real Avatar model path and entrypoint remain unavailable
Voice Profile v2 cannot be built without visual-confirmed clean speech
No real trusted corpus or Creator lexicon is available
No independent human ASR ground truth exists
